about: The ONE definition of 'a process name that counts as a desktop keyring daemon' (DN10 of todo/PLAN_kimi_and_vibe_on_native_linux.md, E1.S2). Each vector is a process name, as a process's executable name or its kernel comm (cut at 15 characters), and whether the keyring-session fact counts it. Read by the product's reading (src_mcp/runners/Platform/KeyringSessionFacts.cs, through src_mcp/tests/KeyringSessionFactsTests.cs) AND by the facts script's own independent reading (scripts/lib/host-facts.mjs, through host-facts.test.mjs). The two READINGS stay independent code; only this definition is shared, so changing what counts as a daemon in one place turns the other side red until it is changed too.
